cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

mechanism: A uses assumed control of a family photograph to grant a shared smile only after spoken remorse.
confusable: Status must govern the maneuver, not merely decorate a request for more expressive texts.
comparison: Public timing and spoken versus written apology differ from private coffee and correcting an apology's target.
seedUse: Canonical D03-b supplies family timing and inadequate text remorse; S01-b supplies permission over ordinary participation. The photograph is a new local setting.
